text:
monica: FYI: were launching a Burst Protection & Rate Smoothing update to billing next month (effective 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC). Purpose: reduce charge volatility for customers with short, high-intensity bursts.

monica: What changes: 1) a 48-hour smoothing window before moving customers into a higher rate tier; 2) an automated small "burst-protection" credit pool applied when transient peaks trigger temporary overages; 3) new invoice CSV flag and billing API parameter.

kevin: Finance details: burst-protection credits show as invoice line "burst_protection_credit". Cap per account per month: $1,000 during rollout. Retro claim window: 30 days. Credits are non-refundable and applied as a single credit line on the next invoice cycle.

harpreet: Eng notes: no change to per-token pricing. Metering will emit redwood.billing.burst_peaks and redwood.billing.smoothing_flags. API: add header X-Redwood-Burst-Smoothing: 1.0 accepted at launch; old header supported 60 days then deprecated. CSV sample: 

account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,burst_peaks,applied_burst_credit,burst_credit_amount

kevin: Dedicated/reserved customers are not auto-enrolled and keep contract terms. They will see passive indicators in the console. If they opt in, support can enable burst protection for them.

harpreet: UX: we'll display a small indicator on the billing page and a tooltip: "Burst Protection: 48h smoothing to avoid billing spikes." Banner to appear 10 days before cutover.

monica: Support ops: prepare short canned replies. Example: "Will I lose credits if I upgrade?" -> "No, credits are applied automatically and shown on your invoice; upgrading does not remove existing credits during the billing period."

billing-bot: Billing API update: new query param ?include_burst=true returns detailed burst credit lines. Backwards compatible if omitted.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-BURST-2026 and added tasks to the Nov cutover checklist. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-BURST-2026 :white_check_mark:

kevin: Action items: @kevin finalize credit rules doc and sample invoice. @harpreet publish API header + CSV schema. @monica coordinate banner and customer comms. @ops-bot monitor rollout metrics and report weekly.

monica: Will run a support dry-run next week. Ping here if you need customers excluded from the pilot. Thanks all :thumbsup:
